description: This file contains the implementation of an 'Edit' feature in a web application, specifically handling editing articles. It defines data models, validation, and the request handler for updating articles, including managing associated tags and handling database operations.

classes.name: Edit.ArticleData
classes.description: Data transfer object representing article details such as title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Represents the command to edit an article, including the article model and its slug.

classes.name: Edit.Model
classes.description: Encapsulates the article data within the command.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the command, ensuring the article data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the edit command by updating the article and its tags in the database.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Main method to process the update request, handle database retrieval, modification, and saving of an article.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags should be removed from the article.
